correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 49 support histories from the simultaneous rule, computing recurrence by repetition and, separately, the color permutation around each recurrent support cycle. A full state cannot be periodic before support recurrence. At support entry the lap map on each support is onto, hence a permutation; because each supported color occurs, its order gives the exact multiple of the support period required to restore every labelled vertex. The recurrent cases have (support period, lap order) (1,1), (1,3), and (2,2), as claimed. Weighting support cardinalities by the numbers of surjections onto the prescribed colors verified every coefficient, including all zero classes, for positive shore sizes. The sole t=4 class is all-rest with coefficient 2u+2U+v+V, positive outside K_(1,1); the singleton-only restriction has two states of depth three. Replay: python3 /workspace/audit_evidence/excitation.py. This is an exact proof of the uniform census, not extrapolation from the recorded direct tests.
